ranking._comment: Default blend used for the 'Best overall' sort in the UI. The UI can override these live.
ranking._bullseyeComment: Some sources return only a snippet, so a posting whose title names one of her exact roles cannot earn skill points it deserves. Such a title floors the match here, provided nothing in the posting counts against it. Raise bullseyeTitleWeight to make the floor apply to fewer title groups.
ranking._unnamedEmployerComment: Reposting sites list themselves as the employer, so you cannot tell who is actually hiring. Those postings still appear, but sort lower by this fraction. Set to 0 to treat them like any other listing.
ranking._discoveryComment: Controls the 'new directions' feature — roles outside her current title. A posting whose title names a roleFamily always qualifies. A posting with no recognisable title must instead evidence discoveryMinCapabilities distinct abilities, which is what keeps keyword coincidences out. discoveryFloor lifts these clear of the 'possible' band so they are actually seen; incumbentTitleWeight is how core an existing title must be to outrank a new-direction label, and roleFamilyTitleWeight is what a family title is worth on its own.
